name: coffee-compost-console
description: Operator console for the coffee-compost factory: discovers the roster from GET /v1/capabilities and drives the platform's own routes.
//: No JS toolchain runs at image build or run time. The console is a single self-contained page at frontend/dist/index.html; python3 build.py validates it and renders the copy the image serves at app/static/index.html. The TSX sources under src/ are the maintained source of that page and are kept in step with it by hand. `npm run build` runs the stdlib-only build script; no package is downloaded.
